people.name: Fountain_Gate
people.line: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time

translations.web: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.
translations.bsb: Then I went on to the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was no room for the animal under me to get through;
translations.kjv: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
translations.asv: Then I went on to the fountain gate and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
